newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S ZUMA SETS NEWS CONFERENCE ON DRUG BILL.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S ZUMA SETS NEWS CONFERENCE ON DRUG BILL.

text.p: South African Health Minister Nkosazana Zuma will hold a news conference on Thursday to discuss three controversial bills she withdrew from parliament last week, her spokesman said on Wednesday.
The news conference at 1.30 p.m. (1130 GMT) follows discussions on revisions to the bills at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
Zuma has said she plans only minor technical changes to the bills, one of which raised a storm of protest in the pharmaceutical industry.
Drug manufacturers objected to provisions for the promotion of generic medicine and for the parallel importation of branded drugs, measures which Zuma said would bring down medical costs.
